summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching notice of a Class A shareholder meeting and an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to approve a variation of Class A share rights and an increase in authorized share capital. The meetings are scheduled for June 5, 2026, to consider proposals to increase Class B share voting rights and the number of Class B shares. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR the proposals. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is disclosed; this is a routine capital structure change.
